title: Describe a cell diagram
objective: Help your partner draw what you see.

slides.title: Look closely at the cell diagram
body: Diagram A: one oval cell. One dark dot is near the top.
Look for the shape, the number of dots and their position.

slides.title: Listen to a description
body: A: I can see one oval cell.
B: Where is the dark dot?
A: It is inside the cell, near the top.
Say the three lines with a partner. Then swap roles.

slides.title: Describe and draw
body: B: Face away from the screen. Draw what A describes.
A: Describe Diagram B in three sentences.
Diagram B: two oval cells side by side, one dot in each center.
B: Ask one question before you look.

slides.title: Check and try again
body: Compare the drawing with Diagram B.
Which detail matched? Which detail needs a clearer sentence?
Swap roles. Draw a new cell with two dots. Describe it.

slides.title: One final observation
body: Point to a feature in your partner’s drawing.
Say one sentence about its shape, number or position.
Your partner points to the feature you mean.
